Data: Environment and Climate Change Canada, Water Survey of Canada (station 08NE049). Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
texto_aprovado: A large part of it arrives by way of Canada. You can read that off two gauges. A gauge is just a station on the bank that records how much water is going past. One of them sits in British Columbia, a short way north of the border. The other is far downstream at The Dalles, a place on the river in Oregon where the United States government measures it.
